rot.ideia.ex1.e1: The game is also drawn when neither side has enough pieces to give checkmate.
rot.ideia.ex1.e2: Whoever is left with only king and knight, or only king and bishop, cannot give mate, whatever the colour.
rot.ideia.ex1.e3: Here Black has a knight and a pawn; you only have the king. If the pawn survives, it can become a queen.
rot.ideia.ex1.p: Make the move that secures the draw, or click {verResposta}
rot.ideia.ex1.certo: That's right! Without the pawn, Black is left with king and knight: a draw.
rot.ideia.ex1.revela: The king captures the pawn on d5. King and knight are left, and they cannot mate.
rot.ideia.ex1.fora: The pawn is still alive and can become a queen. Let's go back: the king is right next to it.
rot.ideia.ex1.volta: Make the move that secures the draw, or click {verResposta}
rot.ideia.ex1.l1: The draw is automatic: with king and knight, no move leads to mate.
rot.ideia.ex1.l2: Remember the idea: when you are losing, capturing the last pawn can save the game.
rot.ideia.ex2.e1: Another draw: the same position happens three times, with the same side to move.
rot.ideia.ex2.e2: Here Black has an extra rook. But your queen can give checks non-stop: perpetual check.
rot.ideia.ex2.e3: Start with a check on the last rank.
rot.ideia.ex2.p: Give check on the last rank, or click {verResposta}
rot.ideia.ex2.certo: That's right! Check, and the black king can only go to h7.
rot.ideia.ex2.revela: The queen goes to e8: check. The black king only has h7.
rot.ideia.ex2.fora: Without check, Black gains time to attack. Let's go back: the queen goes up to the last rank.
rot.ideia.ex2.volta: Give check on the last rank, or click {verResposta}
rot.ideia.ex2.l1: The black king goes to h7.
rot.ideia.ex2.l2: The queen gives check again, from h5.
rot.ideia.ex2.l3: The black king can only go back to g8.
rot.ideia.ex2.l4: And the queen goes back to e8: the same position as before.
rot.ideia.ex2.l5: This repeats until the third time, and the game is drawn. This is perpetual check.
rot.ideia.ex2.l6: Remember the idea: check after check, without end, saves the side that is losing.
rot.ideia.ex2.l7: Now I will show two more draws.
rot.demos.insuficiente.e1: King and bishop against a lone king: the bishop only reaches squares of one colour and cannot close the others.
rot.demos.insuficiente.l1: That is why the draw is automatic as soon as only these pieces are left.
rot.demos.insuficiente.l2: The same goes for king and knight, and for the two kings alone.
rot.demos.cinquenta.e1: Here the rook can give mate, given enough moves. But there is a limit: the 50-move rule.
rot.demos.cinquenta.l1: If each side makes 50 moves with no capture and no pawn move, either player can claim a draw.
rot.demos.cinquenta.l2: In the course endings, you learn to give mate well before that.
rot.demos.cinquenta.l3: Now it's your turn: first capturing to draw, then with perpetual check.
rot.pratica.ultimoPeao.enunciado: The black pawn will become a queen next move. Make the move that secures the draw.
rot.pratica.ultimoPeao.fim: Perfect. With king and knight, Black cannot mate: a draw.
rot.pratica.perpetuo.enunciado: Save the game with perpetual check, as in the example: check on the last rank, on the diagonal, and back.
rot.pratica.perpetuo.fim: Well done. The position repeats, and it is a draw. You have finished the rules of the game.
